summary: Re-test / bug-fix verification pass for Long Distance Couples Photobooth. PRIMARY GOAL (pixel-content verification of blank-camera fix) is CONFIRMED FIXED: using two isolated Playwright browser CONTEXTS (not just pages - critical fix to test setup since localStorage/pb_role is shared across pages within the same context, which initially caused a false 'guest video blank' result due to role collision) with distinct animated-color canvas.captureStream() fake camera shims, sampled actual pixel data via canvas drawImage+getImageData on both host and guest camera-video elements post-enable: both showed fully non-zero/non-black pixel content (7680/7680 non-zero samples). After completing a full 3-round session, sampled pixel data of the final result-strip-image on both host and guest sides: both showed fully non-black content (100260/100260 non-zero samples), confirming the useEffect re-attach fix in Room.jsx works correctly. Reconnect-mid-round fix also verified: disconnected guest mid-round-1 (host correctly showed abandoned-state), reconnected guest before grace window expired, and both sides cleanly returned to 'both_ready' state (START COUNTDOWN button, not stuck mid-round) confirming session.reset_for_retake() is called on reconnect. Regression checks passed: invalid session code shows not-found-state, mobile viewport (390x844) landing page renders correctly.
action_items: Self-disconnect UX (ws.onclose -> abandoned-state with 'Connection lost...' message) could NOT be reliably triggered/verified in this browser-automation environment: page.context.set_offline(True) and route-blocking do not reliably force-close an already-established WebSocket connection in headless Chromium within a reasonable test window (waited 10s, connection stayed open per app state). This is a test-environment limitation, not a confirmed app bug. Code review of Room.jsx lines 191-196 shows the ws.onclose handler correctly sets selfDisconnected=true and transitions phase to 'abandoned' when in an active phase, and the abandoned-state render block (lines 362-374) correctly branches on selfDisconnected to show 'Connection lost. Please refresh the page to try reconnecting.' vs the partner-disconnected message. Recommend either a manual test or a follow-up automated test using CDP Network.closeWebSocket if tooling allows, but logic appears correctly implemented by code review.
critical_code_review_comments: Room.jsx: the new useEffect keyed on [phase] correctly re-attaches streamRef.current to videoRef.current.srcObject on every phase change, fixing the root cause (video element not mounted at initial assignment time). Verified via pixel sampling, not just DOM presence.

server.py finalize_strip(): host_photos/guest_photos list construction now correctly inside the try block, so a KeyError there triggers the except-branch (broadcast error + reset_for_retake) as intended, and the finally block always discards captures regardless of outcome. Correct.

server.py websocket_endpoint(): reconnect-after-abandoned path now correctly calls session.reset_for_retake() before re-broadcasting both_ready, avoiding stale round/captures resumption. Verified functionally end-to-end.
ResultPanel.jsx: DialogDescription with sr-only class was added since the previous test round, silencing the earlier Radix accessibility console warning noted in iteration_1.

success_rate.backend: not re-tested per request (code review only, prior 8/8 pytest unaffected)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows passed (pixel-verified camera fix, pixel-verified strip fix, reconnect-mid-round reset, invalid code, mobile layout)

context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT test-setup learning: when testing two-party WebSocket flows for this app with Playwright, host and guest MUST be in separate browser CONTEXTS (browser.new_context()), not just separate pages/tabs of the same context - localStorage (which stores pb_role_{code}) is shared across all pages in a single context, causing both 'host' and 'guest' pages to collide on the same role if both navigate to /room/{code} without contexts being isolated. Use context.add_init_script with a localStorage.setItem for the host role (mimicking Landing.jsx handleStartSession) and leave guest context's localStorage untouched so it naturally goes through the join_prompt -> role=guest flow (mimicking handleJoinSession). Fake camera shim: inject a canvas.captureStream()-based MediaStream with an animated hue-rotating fillRect via requestAnimationFrame BEFORE page.goto so getUserMedia is monkey-patched pre-load; then sample pixels via a temporary canvas + drawImage + getImageData on the video/img element to verify non-blank content (count pixels with any RGB channel > 5 as 'nonZero'). Self-disconnect UX (ws.onclose in own browser) remains unverified via automation - context.set_offline() does not reliably force-close an already-open WebSocket within Chromium's headless mode in a short test window; would need CDP-level Network.closeWebSocket support or manual QA.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - the critical blank-camera bug fix was verified working via pixel-level inspection (not just DOM/state checks as flagged as a gap in the previous round). No new bugs found in this pass.
